render_agent_prompt_from_scenario: render an agent system prompt from a scenario JSON and template file
render_prompt_with_custom_exec_tool: render an agent prompt using a custom exec tool name like terminal for Hermes
render_prompt_to_file: render an agent prompt and write it to an output file path
build_exec_approvals: build an exec-approvals JSON config for unrestricted Gaia2 agent execution
run_render_cli: run the render agent prompt CLI with a scenario path and optional output paths
